Amazing experience with craft beer and food!!!
Sep 2019
This is a must try spot in town, located at the end of Bui Vien street: just like a hidden gem. You will have to climb a staircase to 2nd floor, and slide yourself into a super awesome door to come inside. We really love how they did the decoration, very retro with great vibe. Wide range of craft beers from both local and imported together with spirits, sochu, also non-alcohol beverages etc....
We did try the porb rib bbq, chicken wings and tbh they were super super tasty. 
When come here, you guys must try the balcony with the view of Bui Vien street, very breezy and chill.
Worth a try, even for hanging our with friends or dating with your half.
Very nice!!!

Best place for brunch, coffee and craft beer in Bui Vien
Mar 2019 • Friends
The Bem saigon is located in the 2nd floor which is abit not easy to find. However, we had so much fun there. We really love the decoration, vintage retro, industrial. It has a balcony which can see the Bui vien street, i mean it is very very cool.

More over they have a wide range of craft beers, which are very tasty and awesome. We tried the chicken wings, french fries with 3kinds of sauce, and fresh oysters!!! The food were too good to say :) 

You just have to follow the Buivien street, to the intersection of Cong Quynh and Bui Vien, look up to spot Bem Saigon. 

Truly a hidden gem of Buivien!!! Definitely come back again to taste more beers.

Great craft beer in a great location
Nov 2018 • Couples
Great craft beer in a very busy location, though it seems like most people don’t discover it. It’s two stories up and you have to enter through a tiny entrance. When we where there, there were mostly locals hanging out. 

The 🍺 are more expensive than your average 🍻 on Bùi Viện (which I turn are more expensive than your average beer in Saigon), but these are craft beers and damn are they crafty! The passionfruit beer was really good and had great passionfruit flavour 👌🏼. I also tried the jasmine IPA, which comes highly recommended!

Going here is a break from the tourist packed bars along the street, here you can hang out with your friends or some locals and enjoy some great beers.
